open_gaps.detail: Android now has iOS-reference Quick CSV, Doctor PDF, Full archive and Custom presets, inclusive calendar dates and streamed exports (Android commit 7d7d0d3; docs/release/2026-11-07-export-parity). Equivalent cumulative/day-total record semantics and full paired PDF content still require validation; a matching selection UI does not prove equivalent exported data.

Android now implements iOS-reference relationship statistics and a localized Body Signal card for same-morning sleep/resting-heart-rate and next-day sleep/steps, with shared native statistics and threshold cases. Full parity remains open: iOS multi-signal recovery, personal baseline anomalies, trends, streaks, history/rotation and generated narration are not ported; remaining curated inputs are unavailable to this reader. Android uses 60 source-separated days; the current iOS Overview supplies a year store and its relationship evaluator does not apply the declared per-spec window. Paired visual and real Health Connect input validation remain required. RMSSD never substitutes for SDNN.

Android now implements native snapshot/glance, combined health and sync, sync status, sync, Home Assistant, export and configurable action widgets, with dated readings, the hourly steps band and receipt-backed status. See Android docs/release/2026-11-07-widget-parity for emulator evidence. Physical-device background actions, real launcher/lock-screen support and full paired visual equivalence remain unverified or incomplete.
Android uses manual medication drafts; iOS can read medication data. The platform gap needs an explicit product decision and corresponding UI evidence.
Android pairing requires HTTPS; iOS permits a local HTTP destination after confirmation. Decide and test the same supported setup policy.
Changed surfaces have emulator screenshots, but a full paired phone/tablet, state, RTL and accessibility comparison has not been completed.
Real Play-installed purchase/restore and physical-device lifecycle verification remain unproven.
